name: gospelstudio-live-relay
description: Relays GospelStudio live streams from the browser to YouTube, Facebook and any RTMP platform with FFmpeg, without re-encoding.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/main.js --external:ffmpeg-static --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
